rationale: The agent initiated a return via tool call without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the confirmation requirement. The agent also did not ask for or verify the order ID despite the user’s prompt design indicating potential correction steps, and did not confirm which vacuum model to return. Although user identity appears to have been looked up by name and ZIP and the order retrieved (W9502127), the agent failed to provide the requested total refund amount and did not communicate that the return was initiated or provide next steps (labels/RMA). The response only discussed refund timelines (5–7 business days), did not meet the user’s request for a 3‑day refund (while correctly noting it cannot be expedited), and did not answer all user questions. These issues breach the policy (confirmation before writes, complete/correct info), so the conversation fails the pass bar.
